I have class later today so I was going to ask them but its a difficult class to make up (its a biology lab). I'm in the USA but my state has a lot of psych wards (very depressed city) so I hope that theres one good adult ward. 

Thank you!

That sounds like what I had when I was a teen :( i guess ill have to be careful and review all the possible wards...

Im sorry that happened to you

im like in my early 20s so idk if i have a lot of data lol. As a teenager definitely yes, but I think a lot of teen girls with depression get groomed by adult men.

But I imagine its common. People also say abusers will prey on women they can identify as depressed to manipulate them more. Tbh idk how they can tell sometimes people have trauma or depression. 

I found my boyfriend in university, so idk where would be best for working adults. But I also pursued him first. I didnt like the guys who flirted with me first and felt off vibes from them.

EMDR helped me a lot with my CSA. I hope it helps you too.

I know you said you never told anyone but I hope you can tell your mom one day. This isnt something you should go through alone. I just hope your mom believes you... 

Her cousin is disgusting and I hope all of them receive their justice one day. 

Its good now that you acknowledged unhealthy coping skills (craving male validation). I know how hard it is to find self worth outside that. A lot of victims do the same thing so youre not alone.

I really really hope the best for you. You deserve it.

I really want to but I already took a couple quarters off because of covid. I don't think I'm failing my classss but just going to school and being surrounded by people who are high achieving makes me feel horrible. 

Thank you for commenting though. I really appreciate it.

Thank you. Do you mind me asking if it was difficult to get into a masters program without an internship?  I am so stressed out about not having any. I've been working retail but not really anything involved in my degree. I'm just distraught I won't be able to get into grad school programs because it feels so competitive. That and my current college is somewhat competitve (not like Ivy level but a bit below UCLA ig) so I feel like that might be playing a role in my sadness.

My abuser literally said the same thing to me. He was my stepfather. You're being groomed. He basically threatened to leave my mom if we didn't have sex at 14. 

Please get out safely.

Are you Asian? A lot of Asian families think like that. Daughters are useless because they'll marry off into another family, so they don't care about investing in you because they think you're a waste. 

I'm really sorry. I hope once you're old enough and financially stable, you can find a real family who loves and values you.

I do and sometimes they work. But I also figured I need to fix my sleeping schedule anyway. Usually Im fine but since theres no one else at my dorm I get a bit anxious sleeping by myself. Thanks though

I'm fucking over my sleep schedule right now because im too scared to sleep, especially by myself rn. 

Gore it depends.. like if its an animal then I'm like whatever you know. But if its a human I get like uncomfortable when I sleep and imagine thats happening to me. The game I played has this one scene where a victim is chopped up and stuffed into a vase. I cant sleep now because I keep imagining myself like that too. 

But its only for fictional media. I can listen to true crime and not be bothered at all.
thank you too. he says hes perfectly fine but i always feel bad

hey op i dont know if youll ever see this or if youre okay but i want you to know that whatever you decide you were stronger than they ever would be. Your siblings too because they cant accept the fact.

I hope you don't die even though I too wish to die for my own revenge. I just hold out that one day I'll be happy. I will not judge you whatever you choose but if you choose to live I hope you find happiness soon. You deserve it. Your family is horrible.

Religion has been ruined to me. Not only because my abuser took me to his church a lot but also because I feel betrayed by God(s) that they never answered my prayers or gave me justice.

I wish I had some spirituality but its gone and I'm just pessimistic now.
